raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The 26.10 Megatron-Bridge source scan flags Pillow 12.3.0 on `r0.7.0` for seven high-severity findings: CVE-2026-112393, CVE-2026-112896, CVE-2026-112900, CVE-2026-112396, CVE-2026-112404, CVE-2026-112403, and CVE-2026-112398. Pillow 13.0.0 contains the upstream fixes.

Require Pillow >=13.0.0 through normal uv constraints in Bridge and the Framework image, and in the Framework system-pip install. Regenerate `uv.lock` so the source package scan resolves the fixed 13.0.0 release while allowing future patched versions.

Validation: `uv lock` completed in the project container; the lockfile resolves Pillow 13.0.0. `uv run --no-sync pre-commit run --all-files` and `git diff --check` passed. A rebuilt image scan on amd64 and arm64 remains necessary to verify installed copies.

Static review complete; no verified actionable findings.

The Pillow minimum is consistent across [Bridge constraints](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/f5638f3d0b226dc28c962cf2c2ae0d4f6429cf26/pyproject.toml#L124-L126), [Framework constraints](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/f5638f3d0b226dc28c962cf2c2ae0d4f6429cf26/docker/common/fw_pyproject.toml#L48-L51), and the [system-pip installation](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/f5638f3d0b226dc28c962cf2c2ae0d4f6429cf26/docker/Dockerfile.fw_final#L100-L109). The [lockfile](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/f5638f3d0b226dc28c962cf2c2ae0d4f6429cf26/uv.lock#L3449-L3458) records Pillow 13.0.0 with CPython 3.12 Linux wheels for both target architectures. The existing tokenizers exclusion is retained.

Tests, image builds, and vulnerability scans were not executed in this read-only review. Installed-copy verification remains necessary to establish image remediation.

No perf tests impacted.

### Suggested test cases
- `bridge_pillow_locked_sync_amd64` (proposed): build the Bridge image through its locked dependency-install path; verify the virtual environment imports Pillow 13.0.0.
- `bridge_pillow_locked_sync_arm64` (proposed): repeat the locked build and Pillow version/import checks on arm64.
- `framework_pillow_installations_amd64` (proposed): rebuild the Framework stack; verify Pillow ≥13.0.0 under both the virtual-environment and system interpreters, and scan for remaining vulnerable copies.
- `framework_pillow_installations_arm64` (proposed): repeat the Framework interpreter checks and image scan on arm64.
- [TestTensorToPil.test_conversion](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/f5638f3d0b226dc28c962cf2c2ae0d4f6429cf26/tests/unit_tests/data/energon/test_task_encoder_utils.py#L107-L111): retain the assertion that converting a three-channel 4×4 tensor produces a PIL image of size `(4, 4)`.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*
